gloss: school attendance day; day when school is in session

definitions.gloss: school attendance day; day when students must attend school
definitions.explanation: A day designated for students to attend school. Often refers specifically to special attendance days during school breaks (summer, winter, spring) when students are required to come in briefly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{登校日|とうこうび}だ。
⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登校日|とうこうび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are school attendance days during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登校日|とうこうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{具合|ぐあい}→具合：01391_guai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: On the summer vacation school attendance day, we have to report our homework progress to the teacher.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{登校|とうこう}→登校：16560_toukou⟧ (attending school, going to school) + {日|び} (day). Particularly associated with the designated days during school breaks when students must come to school.

USAGE:
In Japanese schools, long vacations (especially summer break) often include one or more {登校日|とうこうび} — days when students come to school briefly for announcements, to submit homework, or to participate in activities. These are different from regular school days and usually involve shorter hours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登校日|とうこうび} — summer vacation attendance day
- {登校日|とうこうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ — to go on a school attendance day
- ⟦{全校|ぜんこう}→全校：28166_zenkou⟧{登校日|とうこうび} — whole-school attendance day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{登校|とうこう}→登校：16560_toukou⟧ — going to school, attending school (the act itself)
- {出席日|しゅっせきび} — attendance day (more formal, record-keeping context)
- {休校日|きゅうこうび} — school closure day (the opposite)
